set.body: At the pinned eyesim revision, run eye_table, as_eye_table, fixation_group and coords on valid, clipped, invalid-duration, duplicate-key and empty-group inputs. Compare eyes4s FixationCsv admission and Trials construction. Preserve every input row as accepted or rejected data, state time and duration units, and add offline JVM and Scala.js fixtures plus PARITY.md findings. Exit when silent clipping, grouping and ordering behavior are measured and every intended difference has an independent accounting assertion.
